newsitem.title: USA: No restart time yet for Diablo Canyon nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: No restart time yet for Diablo Canyon nuclear unit.

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co said midday Wednesday it had not yet determined a specific cause for the feedwater system problem which led to the manual shut-off 0500 PDT/0800 EDT Wednesday of its 1,073 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon nuclear unit 2.
As a result, the company did not expect to be able to estimate a restart time or date for the unit until about 1700 PDT/2000 EDT, a spokesman said.
The unit remained in hot standby mode, PG&E said.
Diablo Canyon's 1,087 MW unit 1 was still operating at full power.
